title: Card Surcharge on the Homesite Reservation Reinstatement Fee
content:
The reinstatement card surcharge on the fee for reinstating an expired Homesite Reservation hold is read from how the reservation deposit received on the expired hold was paid, counting only the payments received on the reservation ledger with the component reservation deposit.

**Clause.** The reinstatement card surcharge is **10** percent where card payments make up the whole reservation deposit received on the expired hold, **5** percent where card payments make up part but not all of it, and nothing where no part of it was paid by card.

## Ledger cases (hypothetical)

1. The reservation deposit of 1000.00 was paid by card in full: 10 percent.
2. Of a reservation deposit of 1500.00, 750.00 was paid by card and 750.00 by ACH: 5 percent.
3. The reservation deposit was paid by check; a later swap fee was paid by card: nothing, since the swap fee is not reservation deposit.
4. The reservation deposit was paid by card and a card convenience fee was booked beside it: 10 percent; the convenience fee is its own component.
